title: iRexPro AI V2 decision record (research contract C1-C6)
description: Machine-readable canonical form of the V2 decision-record contract. Structural encoding of invariants C1-C6: one confidence field (additionalProperties:false rejects any second confidence-named key), the six uncertainty slots, as-of provenance with supersede counter, commission-inclusive economics, explicit drift state, policy-layer reference by hash. Semantic checks beyond this schema (e.g. C1 sizing rules on uncalibrated confidence) live in v2-decision-record-contract.cjs; a record is valid only when BOTH the schema and the contract pass. Research-only artifact; no runtime path consumes it.

decisionRecordSchema.description: Self-declaring schema version; the loader refuses unknown versions.

decisionId.description: Stable identity for supersede chains and outcome linkage (fill -> decision SHA join).

decisionAt.description: Decision-time UTC ISO-8601 instant, recorded before the outcome window.

value.description: C1: the ONE confidence scalar; semantics fixed as calibrated P(win).

calibration.description: C1: declared calibration state; uncalibrated values are provenance-only.

calibrationVersion.description: Bundle/pin identifier of the calibrator that produced this value.

uncertaintySlots.description: C2: the six abstention-uncertainty slots stay separate; null means explicitly unknown.

recordedBeforeOutcome.description: C3: decision-time write; false means the record is retrospective and must be flagged.

supersedeCount.description: C3/P6: re-evaluations are counted, never silently dropped (V1 first-write-wins defect).

reconstructed.description: C3: true flags retrospective reconstruction; it is recorded, not accepted silently.

asOf.description: UTC ISO-8601 as-of instant of the evidence snapshot.

expectedNetR.description: C4: after-cost expected-R; required for EXECUTE, null for non-executable records.

costModelVersion.description: C4: versioned cost model so the V1 3x cost understatement is attributable.

includesCommission.description: C4: spread-only cost models are rejected.

executionIntent.description: SUPERSEDED records stay in the append-only ledger with their supersede count.

driftState.description: C5: explicit drift input; OOD is recorded as OOD, never re-labelled.

policyVersionSha.description: C6: hash of the versioned policy layer that owns all permissions; no inline carve-outs.
